news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹7.97 (vs ₹6.12 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹7.97 (up from ₹6.12 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹13.2b (up 19% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹141.8m (up 35% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 1.1% (up from 0.9% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 36% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 65% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 10% a week. This is considered a major risk.
